text_block_list.text:
The GⅡ race, the Kinko Sho, was finally here.
She seemed calmer than she had ever been before.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If I win here, I'll get a ticket to even faster races, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it so much, I just can't wait.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how far I can go today...
I can't stop thinking about that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I have a hunch that we're going to see
something truly special.
choice_data_list: Go and enjoy yourself to the fullest!
